{{Quote|Since yousa ganna be da pilot, Commander Wollod, mesa let-ten yousa choose da bongo.|Boss Nass to Wollod|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref>}}
'''Wollod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], he was already an aged Gungan, as reflected by his whiskers. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Wollod served in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]], bearing the title of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]].
